children: Hecla Mining established a new $500 million senior secured revolving credit facility, featuring a $100 million accordion and maturing on Sep 16, 2030, with a one-year extension option. Proceeds may be used for working capital, capital expenditures, and other general purposes, including refinancing. In connection with the new facility, Hecla terminated its 2022 credit agreement on Sep 16, 2026, with obligations repaid or replaced. The refinancing is expected to enhance liquidity and financial flexibility under customary covenants.
: Senior secured revolving credit facility (with $100 million accordion)
: Bank of America and other lenders
: Until Sep 16 2030; option to extend 1 year
: Enhance liquidity and refinance prior facility
: Replaced by new revolving credit facility
